page_title: BOU 1-0 EVE | Bournemouth v Everton 04/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' David Brooks (Bournemouth) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' Ashley Young (Everton) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
87' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when John Brooks blows for a foul.
84' Beto (Everton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul.
83' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Philip Billing (Bournemouth) for Evanilson.
81' Sean Dyche has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Beto (Everton) replacing Idrissa Gueye.
79' A player from Everton commits a rough challenge. John Brooks blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

77' 1 - 0 What a goal! Milos Kerkez plays it to David Brooks (Bournemouth), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Jordan Pickford into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
74' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) whips in a cross from the corner, but Jordan Pickford is well positioned and punches the ball away.
72' Nathan Patterson (Everton) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
71' The game is interrupted. Evanilson (Bournemouth) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
71' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. David Brooks (Bournemouth) replaces Dango Ouattara.
70' Today's match ends for James Hill who will be replaced by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth).
70' Substitution. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Justin Kluivert walks off.

68' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
67' John Brooks blows his whistle as Evanilson (Bournemouth) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
65' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Bournemouth! Play can continue.
65' There's a break in play and referee John Brooks must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bournemouth using VAR. This could be interesting!
65' That looked a certain handball by Nathan Patterson (Everton) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
63' The resulting set piece from Bournemouth is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
61' The free kick from Ashley Young (Everton) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
60' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Everton are awarded a free kick.
56' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:6. 6:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
53' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bournemouth.
52' Harrison Armstrong (Everton) meets a cross inside the box, but Mark Travers wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
49' Evanilson (Bournemouth) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
48' Corner kick. Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is ready to send the ball into the box.
48' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
47' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
46' Sean Dyche makes a half-time substitution. Harrison Armstrong comes on in place of Orel Mangala (Everton).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) is replaced by Nathan Patterson.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) works the corner short.
45+1' John Brooks blows for a foul after Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

45+1' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Jordan Pickford makes a comfortable save.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Everton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
40' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
39' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
38' The corner from Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is intercepted by Jordan Pickford.
37' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and John Brooks blows for a foul.
33' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Sean Dyche is forced to make a change. Armando Broja is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton).
31' Armando Broja (Everton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
29' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Jordan Pickford.
28' Evanilson (Bournemouth) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
26' Orel Mangala (Everton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. John Brooks has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
25' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

24' What a huge chance for Evanilson (Bournemouth). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
24' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
24' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Bournemouth.
22' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
22' Armando Broja (Everton) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
20' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' The game is interrupted now, Armando Broja (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
16' Ashley Young (Everton) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.

15' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left John Brooks no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Everton.
14' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) has a goal ruled out for offside!
13' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post.
11' Orel Mangala (Everton) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
10' The resulting corner, taken by Ashley Young (Everton), comes to nothing.
9' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) commits a rough challenge and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.

8' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
5' The Everton players are exchanging some short passes.
4' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Bournemouth is cautioned for aggressive play.
2' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
1' Ashley Young (Everton) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
1' The first half has just begun.
Everton will kick-off.
John Brooks was nominated as the referee for this game.
